title: Tarn exam blueprint
description: The structure of one question paper: header, sections, choice rules (answer any N of M), OR pairs, sub-parts with their own marks, step marks, the evaluation method of each section and optional links to question ids. Version 1.2 (field schema_version; 1.1 added the optional exam_code; 1.2 adds kind, target_batch, weightage_note, description, descriptor and from_schema, all optional; 1.0 and 1.1 documents are still accepted and read as papers). A blueprint is a schema (a reusable template) or a paper. A schema has no exam code, no from_schema and no linked question: every question_id is null (that last rule is checked by the API, not written here). from_schema must name a schema of the same college and subject (checked by the API). A document that satisfies this schema may still be refused by the API, because some rules are arithmetic and cannot be written here: question and sub-part marks use at most 2 decimal places; sub-part marks and step marks add up to the marks of the question they belong to; the alternatives of an OR pair carry equal marks; 'any N' has N between 1 and the number of items; question numbers, sub-part labels and step labels are unique; and total_marks equals the sum over sections of the marks of the N largest items (all items when the rule is 'all'). The API explains each broken rule with a path and a sentence (POST /api/v1/blueprints/validate). Negative marking is exam-wide and applies to wrong answers in sections evaluated by exact_pattern_match or omr_bubble_scan.

title.description: Exam title, e.g. the header of the paper.

course_code.description: Course code printed on the paper.

exam_code.description: Since 1.1: the code that names this exam (for example MATH-2026-FINAL), unique per college among the papers that carry one. A paper needs one before a unit of work can use it. Empty or absent: none yet.

subject_id.description: The subject (global content) this paper belongs to.

duration_minutes.description: Length of the exam; null when not stated.

total_marks.description: Most a student can earn, choice rules applied.

negative_marking.description: Marks deducted for a wrong answer in an objective section.

mark_step.description: Unit that marks for an answer are rounded to.

kind.description: Since 1.2: a schema is a reusable template whose questions stay unlinked; a paper links its questions and needs an exam code before a unit can use it. Absent: a paper when created, unchanged when updated. A blueprint's kind never changes.

target_batch.description: Since 1.2: the class or batch it is meant for ("2024 batch", "Class 12"); a filter only.

weightage_note.description: Since 1.2: the rubric weightage description (for example 40% conceptual, 60% analytical); shown, not enforced.

description.description: Since 1.2: a short text for the paper's or schema's card.

descriptor.description: Since 1.2: one free-text tag of a paper (Mid-term, Quiz, ...).

from_schema.description: Since 1.2: the schema a paper was generated from; null for a schema.

questionId.description: The question this slot is marked against; null until it is linked.

method.description: Exact Pattern Match, OMR Bubble Scan, Keyword + Formula, Semantic Rubric, Diagram.

steps.description: Marks per step of a worked answer; they add up to the marks they split.

label.description: The number on the paper, e.g. "7" or "12".

parts.description: Sub-parts with their own marks (12a 10 + 12b 5). Link questions on the parts, not on the question.

alternatives.description: Questions of which one counts (the higher score if both are answered). They carry equal marks.

choice.description: "all": every item counts. "any" with n: answer any N of the M items; the best N count and the rest are shown as not counted.
